metadata.title: NER Logistics Primary vs Alternate Routes — OSRM Routed
metadata.note: Waypoints are used to fetch real road routes from OSRM (OpenStreetMap-based routing engine).

properties.routeName: Primary Freight Route: Guwahati → Imphal (via NH-6 / Shillong Corridor)
properties.description: Direct route via Shillong, Jowai, and Haflong. Currently BLOCKED at Dima Hasao due to Landslide.

properties.routeName: AI-Recommended Safe Route: Guwahati → Imphal (via NH-27 & Dimapur Bypass)
properties.description: Bypasses landslide hazard zone via Nagaon, Lumding bypass, and Dimapur NH-2 corridor into Imphal.
